optimize.summary.desc: Optimize applies recommended items only. Context menu, navigation pane and startup items are set individually.
opt.cpu_idle.title: Let the CPU slow down when idle
opt.cpu_idle.desc: The current power plan keeps the CPU at full speed even when idle, producing constant heat. After this change the CPU slows down when idle; performance under load is unchanged.
opt.cpu_boost.title: Allow CPU turbo boost
opt.cpu_boost.desc: The current power plan disables turbo boost, so the CPU never runs above its base clock, even under load. After this change turbo works the Windows default way again; the CPU still slows down when idle.
apps.add.title: Choose a preference for {0}
apps.hint: Choose how apps are scheduled. Apps without a setting use Automatic
pref.auto.desc: Yields when it keeps the processor busy in the background; apps in use or used recently are left alone
pref.always_fast.desc: Never yields performance and is never throttled by Windows
pref.background.desc: Always runs on efficiency cores at lower priority
pref.game.desc: Runs one priority level higher and is never throttled by Windows; switches to the mode chosen for games and uses the dedicated GPU
remedy.none: Cannot be handled separately; resets after a restart
since_boot.title: Compared with startup
since_boot.caption: Up for {0} · Baseline recorded {1}
since_boot.pending: A baseline is recorded about 5 minutes after startup. Changes in system totals appear here afterwards.
since_boot.note: Items marked in orange have grown well beyond normal use. The system cache holds file data that Windows releases automatically when programs need memory, so it is not cleaned.
settings.tray_alert.desc: Show a dot on the tray icon for high temperature, high memory usage and similar conditions
hw.cpu.hybrid: {0} performance cores ({1} threads) + {2} efficiency cores ({3} threads)
apps.smart_schedule.desc: Apps that keep the processor busy in the background move to efficiency cores at lower priority, so the apps you use are not disturbed; games and apps playing sound are never throttled by Windows. Turning it off restores every app
apps.system.desc: Resident system and driver programs, shown for reference. Poise does not adjust system programs
apps.not_running.desc: Apps that have a category or have run before; the category applies the next time they run

updater.title: Poise Update
updater.installing.detail: Allow the installation when Windows asks. Poise closes briefly while it installs; your system settings stay as they are.
updater.done.detail: Poise is running again. Its icon is in the taskbar.
updater.up_to_date.detail: There is no newer version to install.
updater.failed.network: Couldn't reach GitHub, or the download was interrupted. Check your connection and try again from Settings.
updater.failed.verification: The downloaded installer failed verification and was deleted. Try again later from Settings.
updater.failed.declined: Administrator permission wasn't granted, so Poise stays on its current version.
updater.failed.launch: The installer didn't start (security software may have blocked it), so Poise stays on its current version.
updater.failed.install: The installation didn't finish (code {0}). The previous version has been restored.
updater.failed.start: The new version is installed, but the Poise service didn't start. Try restarting your PC.
